serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: -we were here for only 20 minutes…
I wonder what important business she has to attend to. 
More likely she’s just sick of me…
I still have my coffee to finish, I guess I will sit here alone for a while.
Right! Since I sit here with nothing to do, I can call Annalie and ask her out. 
Should I bring {f_botName} too? She and Melissa are kinda on a warpath, so it doesn’t seem like a good idea, at least for now.
She might start sulking, but it’s not like she needs to know about it.
It’s easier to ask for forgiveness than for permission after all.
You: Hey Annalie, it’s me. Do you have time to hang out?
Lady Annalie: Uwah?! What a surprise~ Where you and your lady wanna go?
You: Actually, she won’t be going.
Lady Annalie: Oi, oi! What is that supposed to mean?! Me and you alone?~ Behind your lady’s back~
You: Not exactly. Don’t get too excited.
You: It will be me, you and someone else.
Lady Annalie: I hope it’s nothing cringe like you introducing some male friend of yours to me. I’m not interested in some ‘good guy’! I know a whole bunch of them already!
You: It’s not like that. It’s a girl.
Lady Annalie: A girl? Wait a minute. Do you want to tell me that you know 3 girls?! Color me surprised! 
You: I know more than 3 girls, you know?
Lady Annalie: Yeah, your mom and sisters don’t count!
…
You: About this meeting, will you come?
Lady Annalie: Of course! You, me, some other girl and no {f_botName}? It seems interesting! 
Lady Annalie: But be careful! You are playing a dangerous game!
You: I will manage…
…at least I hope so…
Lady Annalie: When you are ready, just come to my shop to pick me up between 17:00 and 19:00, ok?
You: Sure.
With this out of the way, I should probably go home already. It’s getting late.
